entry.title: BrightAI Closes $97 Million Investment
entry.content:
Links: siliconangle.com | businesswire.com

BrightAI, a Palo Alto-based startup specializing in industrial monitoring, has raised $97 million in a funding round led by Smith Point Capital. The investment, which includes participation from GE Vernova Inc., is intended to scale the company's international presence and its "Physical AI" technology. The startup provides hardware and software solutions designed to detect malfunctioning industrial equipment by monitoring internal components that are not visible to human observers.

The company's product portfolio features "State Stickers," ruggedized sensors that monitor noise and vibrations, and the "Stateful AI Hub," which uses artificial intelligence to analyze sensor data for signs of hardware failure. Additionally, BrightAI offers drone software for erosion detection and meter reading, as well as "Stateful Wearables" that provide technicians with field troubleshooting advice and safety monitoring. BrightAI currently monitors hundreds of thousands of industrial assets across 50,000 sites.
